title: nobody on the call floor can log in
description: Since 9am every agent on the Chennai call floor gets 'Your account has been locked out' at the PC login screen, around 70 people. A supervisor said a new password policy went live overnight. Customer lines are open and nobody can take calls.
label_note: Mass account lockouts after a policy change are an identity issue, so it is access, and it is urgent because a whole customer-facing team is blocked.

title: account for new starter on 1st Dec
description: We have a new claims analyst joining on 1 December. Could her network login, email and claims system access be set up for day one? Same access as the rest of the claims team.
label_note: Planned new-joiner account setup is access, and it is low because nothing is blocked yet.

title: forgot HR portal password
description: I've forgotten my password for the HR portal, which is separate from my normal login. I want to check my payslip and update my bank details this week. The reset page asks for an employee number I don't have.
label_note: A password reset for one application is access, and it is medium because the user's main work isn't affected.

title: new phone, authenticator didnt move over
description: got a new phone yesterday and the authenticator app didnt transfer, old phone already traded in. now every login asks for the code and i cant get one. locked out of email, chat, everything
label_note: Lost MFA registration needs an authenticator reset, so it is access, and it is high because the user is blocked from everything.

title: my account is sending emails I didn't write
description: Colleagues and two clients are asking about an email from me with a 'shared document' link that I never sent. My sent items show about 300 of them from last night. I also got a sign-in alert from another country on Sunday that I ignored.
label_note: A compromised account needs a password reset and session revoke, so it is labelled access and urgent as a security incident; it could be confused with email because the visible symptom is sent mail.

title: mfa every 5 mins
description: getting the authenticator prompt like every 5 mins today, on every app. i approve it and it comes back. cant concentrate
label_note: Excessive MFA prompts are an identity configuration issue, so it is access, and it is medium because the user can still work.

title: can't open Northgate client folder - due today
description: I've been moved onto the Northgate account and need the client's folder on the shared drive, but it says 'Access denied'. The quarterly report is due to the client by 5pm today and the source files are in that folder.
label_note: A folder permission request is access, and it is high because a same-day client deadline depends on it.

title: my name is spelt wrong
description: my name shows as Priyanka Ramesh in the directory and on the login screen, its Priyanka Rameshan. been like this since i joined
label_note: Correcting an identity record is access, and it is low because it is cosmetic.

title: I can see HR's confidential folder
description: While looking for a template I noticed I can open the HR 'Disciplinary - Confidential' folder on the shared drive and read the files. I'm in procurement and definitely shouldn't be able to. I haven't opened anything beyond the file list.
label_note: Over-broad folder permissions are access; priority is debatable because nobody is blocked, but exposed confidential HR data justifies high, and some would treat it as an urgent security incident.

title: SSO error everyone
description: every cloud app login goes to the SSO page then fails with 'SAML response signature validation failed'. whole of finance and hr in mumbai reporting it, other offices too i think. started around 8:30
label_note: An SSO failure affecting every cloud app is identity, so it is access, and it is urgent because many users are blocked.

title: locked out of ERP
description: locked out of erp after 3 tries, cant post anything
label_note: An application account lockout is access, and it is high because the user is blocked.

title: new password keeps getting rejected
description: password expired so im setting a new one and it keeps saying does not meet complexity requirements. ive tried like 10. it has a capital a number and a symbol?? still on my old session for now
label_note: A password policy problem is access, and it is medium because the existing session still works.

title: remove access when Arjun leaves
description: Arjun from my team leaves on the 30th. Please disable his access to the ERP and the team shared drive at end of day on the 30th.
label_note: Planned leaver deprovisioning is access, and it is low because it is a future request.

title: approve button greyed out - is the system broken?
description: The Approve button on purchase requisitions has been greyed out for me since yesterday. I think the procurement system is broken? Requisitions are piling up and a supplier is waiting on an order to start a job tomorrow. My colleague, who is also an approver, can approve fine.
label_note: One approver can approve and the other can't, which points to a missing role, so it is access, and it is high because orders are blocked; the user thinks the software is broken.

title: cant log in
description: cant log in
label_note: The ticket is vague with no system named, so it is labelled access by its only clue, with medium as a placeholder; it would be high if the user is fully blocked, and the cause could equally be network or hardware.

title: ex-employee still logging into CRM
description: A sales rep we let go yesterday afternoon is still logged into the CRM. The audit log shows him exporting customer contact lists at 11pm last night and again this morning. His laptop was handed back, so he must be using the web version.
label_note: A leaver with active access exfiltrating data is an access failure and a security incident, so it is urgent.

title: access to the clinical governance site
description: I've joined the clinical governance group and need access to their team site to read the papers. I'm presenting at Thursday's meeting and the draft agenda is in there.
label_note: A site permission request is access, and it is medium because there is a near deadline but no immediate block.

title: moved to collections - still have old access
description: I moved from billing to the collections team on Monday. I still have all my billing access, but I can't open the collections queue at all, it says I'm not authorised. My new manager has approved it. I've had nothing to work on for two days.
label_note: A role change that wasn't applied is access, and it is high because the user is blocked from their new job.

title: temporary admin access for December migration
description: For the file server migration in December I'll need temporary admin rights on FS-03 for two weekends, the 6th and the 13th. Change request CR-2231 is approved.
label_note: A planned elevated-access request is access and low.

title: expenses app won't sign in on phone
description: I can log into the expenses system fine on my laptop, but the phone app says 'Sign-in blocked: this device isn't registered with your organisation'. I've reinstalled the app twice. I wanted to photograph receipts on the go, but I can scan them at the office for now.
label_note: A device registration or conditional access block is identity policy, so it is access, and it is medium because there is a workaround; it could be confused with software because the error shows in an app.

title: nightly interface stopped - login failed
description: The overnight feed from the ERP to the warehouse system didn't run. The interface log shows 'Login failed for user svc_wms_int: password expired' repeating from 01:00. The warehouse has no orders for today's picking.
label_note: An expired service account password is the root cause, so it is access, and it is urgent because warehouse operations are halted; the symptom in an application interface could get it routed to software.

title: can only read the planning folder
description: i can open files in the production planning folder but cant save, says read only. need to update the weekly plan, for now im emailing my changes to Ravi who saves them
label_note: Missing write permission is access, and it is medium because there is a workaround.

title: prescribing rights missing after renewal
description: My registration renewal went through last week, but since Monday the e-prescribing system lets me view and not prescribe. I'm the consultant on call this weekend and the juniors need me to sign off prescriptions. The other consultant can co-sign today, but he's off from tomorrow.
label_note: A missing clinical role is access; priority is debatable because a co-sign workaround exists today (high), but losing it tomorrow before an on-call weekend could justify urgent.

title: access to old project archive
description: Could I get read access to the 2023 Kolkata warehouse project archive folder? I'm reusing some of their drawings for a new proposal next month.
label_note: A non-urgent folder access request is access and low.

title: back from leave, account disabled
description: hi all, back from parental leave today after 6 months, baby is doing great and finally sleeping more than 3 hours which is a miracle. anyway my laptop says my account is disabled. my manager thinks its because it wasnt used for so long. webmail on my phone still works so im reading the welcome back stuff from hr, manager said today is mostly catch up anyway
label_note: An account disabled for inactivity is access, and it is medium because the user's day is mostly catch-up and phone email works.

title: login page keeps reloading
description: When I try to open any cloud app, the sign-in page flashes and reloads over and over and never gets to the password box. It happens in both browsers on my laptop. On my phone the same apps sign in fine.
label_note: An SSO redirect loop for one user is a sign-in problem, so it is labelled access, and it is high because all cloud apps on the laptop are blocked; it could be a browser cookie issue (software).

title: locked out of timesheets
description: locked out of the timesheet tool after typing my old password, it says try again in 24 hours. timesheets are due friday
label_note: An application lockout is access, and it is medium because the deadline is days away.

title: authenticator prompts not arriving
description: Nobody on our floor is getting authenticator push notifications this morning, and colleagues in Tokyo and Pune say the same. Anyone whose session expired can't get back in. Typing the code from the app fails too with 'verification failed'.
label_note: A company-wide MFA failure is identity, so it is access, and it is urgent because many users are locked out.

title: my badge won't release prints

label_note: The badge isn't linked to the user's print account, so it is access, and it is medium because there is a workaround; it could be confused with hardware (the printer or badge).

title: my account was disabled by mistake
description: I came in this morning and my account is disabled. HR says a person with the same name, who worked in Tokyo, left on Friday, and I think IT disabled me instead of him. I can't log in to anything.
label_note: A wrongly disabled account is access, and it is high because the user is fully blocked.

title: name change after marriage
description: I got married last month and changed my surname. Could my login name, email address and display name be updated? Please keep my old email address working too, so clients can still reach me.
label_note: Updating the identity record is access and low; it could be routed to email because the address change is the most visible part.

title: can't use self-service reset - forgot security answers
description: I wanted to reset my password on the self-service page, but I don't remember the answers to the security questions I set when I joined. My password expires in 3 days.
label_note: Resetting self-service password registration is access, and it is medium because the password still works for now.

title: locked out - auditors arrive in an hour
description: I'm locked out of my account after typing the wrong password a few times. The external auditors arrive in an hour and I'm the one walking them through the finance system.
label_note: An account lockout is access, and it is high because of a time-critical commitment.

title: account keeps locking every morning, hacked??
description: every morning around 8 my account is locked again. i unlock it through the helpline and by the next morning its locked. i changed my password last week. is someone trying to hack me??

title: remove Sanjay's finance access after his move

title: delegate approver while I'm on leave

label_note: A planned delegation request is access and low.

title: switch mfa from sms to app
